verdict.rationale: ROS 2's interfaces are defined in shared message packages that a community member likens to 'a big collection of .proto files' (ros2-comm-20). The official docs say all client libraries implement code generators over these shared definitions (ros2-docs-59), so a machine-readable interface spec loosely equivalent to OpenAPI exists. The pack has no first-party documentation of the interface-definition format, nor any mention of downloading or exporting a consolidated API spec. missing for 10: first-party docs describing the .msg/.srv/.action IDL as a machine-readable spec, a downloadable or exportable spec artifact, an OpenAPI-style catalog or introspection export, hands-on corroboration of AI or agent consumption.
